jt60sa.evidence: EDDB FAME QAXIS is the signed safety factor on the magnetic axis, dimensionless, and positive at every sample on E101154 (min 0.8788, max 1.0564); read through fetch_channels beside Q95, TTCU and BTV. Its sign is not yet scored against the plasma current and F, so the rule stays source-only. Source read and sign recorded by the equilibrium source-leads survey: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads.html

EDDB FAME Q95 is the signed safety factor at the 95 percent flux surface, dimensionless, and positive at every sample on E101154 (min 7.287, max 32.39). The EDDB unit string is '-', so no scale is applied, and its sign is not yet scored, so the rule stays source-only. Source read and sign recorded by the equilibrium source-leads survey: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads.html

EDDB FAME TTCU is the plasma current Ip in A, positive at every sample on E101154 (min 2.860e5, max 9.980e5), read through fetch_channels. It carries the equilibrium half of the sign cohort's plasma-current sign and stays source-only until the cohort scores it and it is checked against the magnetics PSRC Ip. Source read and sign recorded by the equilibrium source-leads survey: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads.html

EDDB FAME BTV carries F = R . BT in T.m (min 5.9851, max 6.0230, positive on E101154). The catalogue declares a 3.0 m reference major radius (machine_map.json description_supplements reference_radius, unit m), so B0 = BTV / 3.0 m and the rule divides by the declared radius through channel_factor; the 1/3.0 conversion is not yet scored against the TF current, so the rule stays source-only. Source read and reference radius recorded by the equilibrium source-leads survey: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads.html
PSRC Ip carries E101154's ~1 MA flat top (max 9.986e5) in A; the EDDB unit string for PSRC/Ip is A, so no scale is applied; sign convention unknown-unvalidated until the convention section proves it.

Raw MDAC magFlxLp1 is SELENE flux loop 1, whose type-6 differential entry in the 53-loop store names [7, 1] and so stores loop 1 minus reference loop 7; the entry carries no flux of its own. The loop-reference fits (docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-loop-reference-rca.html) show loop 1 reaching slope -1 only on E100642, so it stays source-only: its convention is not fixed. Because the entry stores -raw_L up to the global sign, the rule negates: channel_factor -1 in this map's target COCOS 17.
